taste:
This is a rich, savoury mixed grill whose main appeal is the variety of meats on one substantial plate. Steak, sausages, gammon, pork loin and lamb give you a range of textures rather than a meal centred on a single cut. The extra steak and additional sausages make the large version a more substantial choice than the classic Mixed Grill.

Two fried eggs sit on top, with a large portion of golden chips alongside. The emphasis is firmly on quantity and meaty variety, so choose it when that is what you want from a pub meal. If you would rather focus on one type of meat, a steak or gammon dish may be a better fit.
value:
The Large Mixed Grill makes most sense as a value choice when you want the extra steak, additional sausages and substantial overall portion. Its typical price is {price}, with {pricePosition}; prices vary by pub. Compare it with the Mixed Grill before ordering, since the expanded plate is only useful value if it matches your appetite.

[Steak Club](/steak-club) pricing applies on Tuesdays. Participating pubs often include a drink with club meals, and many mains have an eligible drink option. Check the local menu for the applicable price and drink choices rather than assuming every combination is included.
